steps.title: Prepare Cell Pellet
steps.instruction: Prepare a 5x10^7 human cell pellet (fresh or stored at -80°C) in a 50 ml Falcon tube. For E. coli, use an overnight culture in 50 ml LB broth spun down at 4500 x g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cell Resuspension and Lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet and lyse the cells using TLB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend by pipette mixing in 200 µl sterile 1X PBS.
Add 10 ml TLB and vortex at full speed for 5 seconds.
Incubate at 37°C for 1 hour until the solution turns transparent.
Add 100 µl Qiagen Proteinase K (Catalog #19131) or other stock solution to a final concentration of 200 µg/ml.
Mix by slowly rotating end-over-end 3 times.
Incubate at 50°C for 2 hours, mixing every 30 minutes by slowly rotating end-over-end 3 times.

steps.title: First Phenol Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first phase separation to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Prepare two 15 ml Falcon tubes with phase-lock gel.
Split the viscous lysate into the two tubes using a 10 ml serological pipette at slow speed.
Add 5 ml BioUltra TE-saturated phenol (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #77607) to each tube.
Place on a HulaMixer at 20 rpm for 10 minutes (increase speed if a fine emulsion does not form within a minute).
Centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 10 minutes.
Pour the aqueous phases into two new 15 ml Falcon tubes containing phase-lock gel, avoiding the protein layer.

steps.title: Second Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Further purify the DNA using phenol and chloroform-isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 ml buffer saturated phenol (BioUltra TE-saturated phenol) and 2.5 ml chloroform-isoamyl alcohol 24:1 (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #25666) to each tube.
Place on a HulaMixer at 20 rpm for 10 minutes (increase speed if a fine emulsion does not form within a minute).
Centrifuge at 4500 rpm for 10 minutes.
Combine the aqueous phases from both tubes by pouring slowly into a new 50 ml Falcon tube.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 4 ml 5 M ammonium acetate (G-Biosciences Catalog #R012).
Add 30 ml ice-cold absolute ethanol (Merck Millipore Catalog #107017) and observe the DNA precipitate.
Create a hook by melting the tip of a glass capillary in a blue flame.
Hook out the DNA in one piece, lifting it to allow excess liquid to drip off.
Submerge the DNA in a 50 ml Falcon tube containing 70% ethanol until it forms a whitish opaque pellet.
Carefully work the pellet off the glass rod using the rim of an Eppendorf tube and drop it into the tube.
Repeat for any remaining DNA fragments.

steps.title: DNA Washing and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet to remove salts and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 ml 70% ethanol to the Eppendorf tube.
Spin down at 10,000 x g and remove as much 70% ethanol as possible.
Wash again with 1 ml 70% ethanol and spin down at 10,000 x g to remove ethanol.
Let the remaining ethanol evaporate by leaving the tube at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: DNA Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA and verify concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µl EB + Triton-X100 (final concentration of Triton-X100: 0.02%) and incubate without mixing at 5°C for 2 days.
Quantify DNA using Qubit BR assay (target concentration >1 µg/µl).
Check the absorbance spectrum of a 1:10 dilution on a NanoDrop.
If necessary, add more EB+Triton-X100 to adjust concentration to 1 µg/µl without mixing.

steps.title: Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA library for sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pipette 16 µl DNA into a 0.2 ml PCR tube using a cut-off P20 pipette tip; retain the tip.
Remove 1 µl from the tube and quantify using Qubit BR assay to determine actual input.
Add 1.5 µl FRA and 3.5 µl EB+Triton-X100. Using a P20 set to 18 µl and the retained tip, mix up and down slowly 8 times; retain the tip.
Add 1 µl RAP. Using a P20 set to 19 µl and the retained tip, mix up and down slowly 8 times; discard tip.
Incubate at room temperature while priming the flowcell.

steps.title: Flowcell Priming
steps.instruction: Prepare the MinION flowcell for loading.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µl FLT to a tube of FLB, vortex briefly, and spin down to create flush mix.
Place a new flowcell on the MinION and run platform QC.
Remove a small amount of storage buffer from the inlet port using a P1000 and the volume adjustment screw.
Load 800 µl flush mix via the inlet port slowly; wait 5 minutes.
Lift the SpotON port cover and load 200 µl flush mix via the inlet port slowly until a bead of liquid is visible over the SpotON port and siphoned back in.

steps.title: Library Loading
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto the flowcell.

substeps.instruction: Add 34 µl SQT and 20 µl NFW to the library tube.
Using a P100 set to 75 µl with a cut-off tip, mix up and down slowly 5 times.
Slowly pipette the diluted library onto the SpotON port as it is siphoned in. If blocked, load by holding the pipette vertically against the port and positively pipetting the library in.
